items.stem: In quadrilateral PQRS, ∠P = 66°, ∠Q = 114°, ∠R = 66° and ∠S = 114°. Is PQRS a parallelogram? Give the condition used.

items.stem: The diagonals of parallelogram PQRS meet at O. If OP = (2y + 1) cm and OR = (5y − 17) cm, find y and the length of diagonal PR.
items.markingKey: Diagonals bisect each other: 2y + 1 = 5y − 17 ⇒ y = 6; PR = 2 × 13.

items.stem: The sides of a triangle are 14 cm, 8 cm and 13 cm. Find the perimeter of the triangle formed by joining the mid-points of its sides.
items.markingKey: Each side of the mid-point triangle is half a side of the original.

items.stem: A kite (the toy) has the shape of a quadrilateral ABCD with AB = AD and CB = CD. ∠A = 78° and ∠C = 100°. (i) Name the type of quadrilateral. (ii) Which two angles are equal? (iii) Find ∠B and ∠D. (iv) Is ABCD a parallelogram? Why?
items.answer: (i) kite (ii) ∠B = ∠D (iii) 91° each (iv) no; its opposite sides are not parallel/equal
items.markingKey: 1 mark each part.

items.stem: In quadrilateral KLMN, KL ∥ NM and LM = KN = 4 cm, but KL = 7 cm and NM = 11 cm. Is KLMN a parallelogram?
items.markingKey: The parallel sides are unequal, so the other pair is not parallel.

items.stem: Three angles of a quadrilateral are 73°, 73° and 109°. Find the fourth angle.
In △ABC, D and E are the mid-points of AB and AC. If BC = 8 cm, find DE.
items.markingKey: Mid-point theorem: DE ∥ BC and DE = ½ BC.

items.stem: In quadrilateral KLMN, KL ∥ NM and LM = KN = 11 cm, but KL = 14 cm and NM = 18 cm. Is KLMN a parallelogram?
items.markingKey: The parallel sides are unequal, so the other pair is not parallel.

items.stem: A gate in a farmhouse is made in the shape of a parallelogram ABCD with AB = 15 dm, BC = 11 dm and ∠A = 79°. (i) Find CD and DA. (ii) Find ∠B, ∠C and ∠D. (iii) The diagonals meet at O. If AO = 10 dm, find AC. (iv) Find the perimeter of the gate.
items.markingKey: 1 mark each part.

items.stem: The diagonals of a rhombus are 48 cm and 14 cm. Find the length of each side, giving reasons.
items.markingKey: Diagonals bisect at right angles: half-diagonals 24 and 7; side = √(24² + 7²) = 25 (3 marks).

items.stem: The diagonals of a parallelogram …
items.markingKey: (b) Theorem.
options: are always equal
bisect each other
are always perpendicular
bisect the angles
